book.name: Luk
book.title: Luk Yesus nugau Ze naliupet Luk nug sikut weun

content: Yesus nug ebeu du tub kasai meun.
Zobu tub ebu, Yesus go Parisi du banou tub nugau zaueim ee zabun beteun. Dudu agen go erunamau aimai suban pei daremen.
Du tub go gonugau ebeg arab unum neleun, go du Yesus waugab siena, Yesus nug peimai, gonug kasai ze tapaimaranem dudu mui Parisi dudu kanabareun, “Du tub zobu ebu kasai mabun iboin ta tam?”
Go dudu agen koli ze tub murab tam. Guzenina, Yesus nug go ebeu du kasai maimai, palautendai, gonugau uzan waneun.
Guzenina, gonug awareun, “Ag agal mogoi ta donki ta zobu ebu ze ob oug eiman alainuba, ag erunamamen? Go ziwas ebu betei imamamen.”
Go agen koli ze tub aurab tam.
Du nugtal gonugau wanib wag i mamau.
Yesus nug dudu ee zabun zoimai, empip hubabun naliu una, uligaimai, gonug go dudu tatau ze tub mareun.
“Du tub nug na ee banou zabun ulizaba, na beteimai, empip hubabun naliu ebu i hoben. Go du nug du tub banou na mui ereg ulareun go empip hubabun naliu ebu zoimai hubamau.
Du gue na ulizeun gonug zoimai, aizamau, ‘Go empip hubabun hoboi darem, du banou e moromena, hubamau.’ Guzenaba, na dudu wanimag tamacag abai betei hubabun aip numau.

Bo, na du tub nug ee zabun ulizaba, beteiba, dudu ipal ses hoboi darem ebu simai hoben. Guzenemen, go ee atag du zoimai, aizamau, ‘Zai, na wag empip hubabun naliu ebu simai hoben.’ Guzenaba, dudu ipal hoboi darem agen nait ulapwag mamam.
Einen, du in go nugtal gonugau wanib ulag zeu, du gonugau wanib Uwait nugau amegwab banou i usalamau. Du in go nugtal gonugau wanib i ulag zeu, du go wanib go ulagwag mui damau.”
Ig ee zabun inen ularamam?

Guzenaimai koli, Yesus nug ze maraimai, du go ee atag du aureun, “Na ee mis banou maiba, nait zaunar ta, nait amaiar apanar ta, nait atanar i ularen. Einen, go dudu agen na koli ee ameg wabun ulizamam. Na ein igul guzenemen, go agen mui koli guzental guzenamam.
Bo, na ee mis banou maiba, dudu esab tamacag mui, dudu aramag ebeag eg mui, amiag kumi mui dudu ee zabun ularen.
Go igul guzenemen, nait ounab naliu usalamau. Go dudu agen na kolital ulizabun iborain tam. Guzenemen, dudu naliu go noumaimai, koli wasebiag, Uwait nug na suban gumizamau.”
Ee banou agai zabun nugau tatau ze.
Du tub gue, go ebu hoboi dareun go ze go doimai, Yesus aureun, “Du in go Uwait nugau gumiganeun igul araog zumau ziwas ebu Uwait dual hoboimai, ee zaimai, go siksikaimai, naliu damau.”
Guzenina, Yesus nug koli aureun, “Du tub go ee mis banou maimai, dudu asiu go ee alai zabun ze palauteun.
Ee mis banou unum mazi elena, ee zabun ziwas ebu gonugau salau du palautoron, go dudu gonug getal awareun, alai ee zabun betei awareun, ‘Ag alan, ee zabun ziwas meu.’
Go dudu tutak tutak agen koli go salau du auremen. Du tub nug go salau du aureun, ‘Iz em ulis gau memin, iz piabun bitamoroi. Nait du banou betei auren go ougab eg i umau.’
Tub nug eneun, ‘Iz ulis bulumakau houhou gau memin, gonun, go suban salau mamam ta, tam ta, en piabun bitamoroi. Iz ee zabun i bitai. Nait du banou betei auren. Go ougab eg i umau.’
Tub nug eneun, ‘Iz air ulistal omin, gonun, iz i bitai.’

Guzenina, go salau du koli beteimai, gonugau du banou go dudu agen auremen ze unum aureun. Du banou go aigsisilena, gonugau salau du aureun, ‘Na pigai ban uzanan gilan ogeiman mui abu ebuan mui beteiba, dudu esab tamacag mui, ameag kumi mui, aramag eg mui dudu izal zaueim imarai alen.’
Salau du gonug go ze sesamoraimai, koli zoimai, eneun, ‘Du banou, iz nait ze ailemen unum sesamoromin, bo, hubabun pip asiu gaul dareu.’
Guzenaimai, salau du koli gonugau du banou nug palautaimai, aureun, ‘Na abu gasag beteiba, dudu unum gusig ze awaremen, alebiag, go hubabun pip dareu unum iboramam.
Einen, iz petak pet awarem, go dudu amegai ee zabun awaremin, ag izal eebiz ebu ee i zamam.’”
Dudu ag suban dabileiban, Yesus sesamoran.

Ziwas tub, duailel asiu Yesus sesamorai betena, gonug koli kekulaimai, duailel guzenai awareun, Du in izan tapaimoromin du usalabun gonugau memeg anag mui, gonugau wau mui, gonugau gelegul abai, nug mui ereg en umkoskos dabilamau, go izal tapaimoromin du i damau. Go iz tutak en ougab noumamau.
In du iz sesamilabun amau, go gonugau a gegeulanau gamahab tam, go izal tapaimoromin du i usalamau.
Du tub go zau mabun, go hoboi daimai, suban dabilaneu. Go zau poabun iboin ta, tam ta aimai dabilaneu.
Go igul go dabelab tam, go zau pigai i poamau, dudu ipal agen go zau i poaba uligaimai, weloromam.
Goagen enamam, ‘Du gue zau meun go pigai pet salau poab tam,’ guzenamam.

Emgasag ebuan gumaraneu du tub go gonugau malai dudu mui, emgasag tub ebuan gumaraneun du tub mui gonugau malai dudu asiu mui malaininabun, du banou go suban hoboi daimai, du banou tub go dual erunai malaininabun suban dabilaneu. Gonugau malai dudu mui ipal malai dudu mui malaininabun iboin ta, tam ta, guzenai dabilaneu.
Gonugau dabeleu go dudu ipal abai malaininabun iboin tam, gonun, gonugau iwai zaug pulig dabi dabi, gonugau salau du tub palautaba, betei du tub peimai, auramau, ‘Ig ag abai alalab utem.’”

Yesus go ze go awaramai, awareun, “Abu tutak sag. Du in go izal tapaimoromin du dabun amau, go gonugau esab unum semoroi maimai, go esab en dabeleu asiu i umau, go izal tapaimoromin du tuguiai damau.”
Ipal Kristen duailel ag siu kel tamacag sul.
Yesus nug koli eneun, “Siu naliu go kel a. Bo, gonugau kel betei munug usalaba, koli kel a usalabun sul iborain tam.
Go siu ougem mui ipal salau mui mabun sul iborain tam. Ig gaul oi amanem. Ag dabuiag mui aba, ag go ze don.”
